verdict.rationale: Financial Connections docs show an official client SDK method, collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts, used to launch the auth flow with a server-issued client_secret. Stripe's llms.txt also references installing Stripe packages from npm, which implies official SDK packages, but the pack never names server-side SDKs, languages, or reference docs. The MCP server and CLI are separate tools and are not credited here. missing for 10: explicit list of official server/client SDKs and supported languages, SDK reference documentation for Financial Connections objects, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts to launch the authentication flow from your client using the client_secret returned by your server
When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
